text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Dantsu Flame was staring
intently at a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
They covered the last race,
and there was even a little mention of me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am happy. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... well, the popular girls
always end up splash right across the front cover,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When I compare myself to a girl like that,
it reminds me that I've still got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame is steadily growing stronger through training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, mentally... no matter how much praise she receives, she doesn't seem quite able to gain confidence.
choice_data_list: For a Dants like you... here, take this!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...!
choice_data_list: It's a fan letter for Dantsu!
It's a fan letter addressed to Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah...
W-W-W-Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's addressed to me...!
Um, may I read it right away?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright then...! Um...
'Dear Dants Flame,
I'm sorry to write to you so suddenly'

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: "I happened to see you at an exhibition race before... and I've been cheering for you ever since!"

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Dantsu-san's running is so much more intense
and passionate than I ever imagined.
It always blows me away."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: ""In today's racing world, there are countless Umamusume who could be called stars.""

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes bold, sometimes dazzling.
There may be times when you are tossed about at the mercy of the era."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... watching you continue to run
without giving up through all of it... you appear
to shine dazzlingly, just like a blazing flame."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: "And from that light, I myself draw great courage."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: "I believe that the stage of racing is where you shine the brightest."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hehe.
It's a little embarrassing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... I'm happy.
That you're watching me so closely..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san!
Can we move today's training up and start right now?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because I have to get even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger, do so well
that I make the cover of a magazine someday...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To the people who believe in me...
I want to say thank you!
